en.name: Apple iPhone 16 128GB
en.shortDescription: Apple's latest 6.1" Super Retina XDR phone with the A18 chip and a 48 MP main camera.
en.description:
## Apple iPhone 16

A 6.1-inch Super Retina XDR display, the A18 chip and a 48 MP main camera with 2x optical-quality zoom.

- 6 GB RAM, 128 GB or 256 GB storage
- IP68 water and dust resistance
- 5G, NFC for Apple Pay
- Ceramic Shield front cover

Sold with the official Apple warranty via our East Africa partner.
